We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (template_id 74054) to the molecule given in make_8_lvl1-apply_template-5 answer: ["O=C1CC2(CCC2)Oc2ccc([N+](=O)[O-])cc21"].

So target molecule SMILES: O=C1CC2(CCC2)Oc2ccc([N+](=O)[O-])cc21

We need to apply template 74054 to this molecule, get list of precursor SMILES combinations.

We have tool apply_template which takes molecule_smiles and template_id.

Let's call apply_template with that SMILES and template_id 74054.
